At least 18 flights faced bomb threats, but they all landed safely.
lines.ko: 적어도 18개 항공편이 폭탄 위협을 받았지만, 모두 안전하게 착륙했어.

lines.en: Eighteen flights? Were bombs found?
No explosives found, but Irish and UK media were also affected.
lines.ko: 폭발물은 발견되지 않았지만, 아일랜드와 영국의 언론사들도 영향을 받았어.

lines.en: What happened to the new arch?
A federal judge temporarily stopped construction work.
Why did this happen so fast?
lines.ko: 왜 이렇게 빨리 이런 일이 일어났죠?

lines.en: The judge issued a 14-day block after the planning commission approved it.
lines.ko: 계획위원회 승인 후 판사가 14일간의 금지 조치를 내렸습니다.

lines.en: Only fourteen days?
Yes, it is a 14-day block on the DC monument.
lines.ko: 네, 워싱턴 기념물에 대한 14일간의 차단 조치입니다.

lines.en: What should we watch next?
Watch for updates after this major setback for the project.
lines.ko: 이 프로젝트의 주요 차질 이후 최신 소식을 지켜보세요.

lines.en: What happened to the activist?
He got ten years in prison.
Why did this happen?
He pleaded guilty under the security law.
How long is his sentence?
He was sentenced to 10 years.
When was he put away?
He has been in prison since 2020.
